rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something funny or intentionally comic.

example.english: That stand-up routine is really amusing.
example.traditional: 嗰套棟篤笑真係好搞笑。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 dung6 duk1 siu3 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaau2 siu3

rows.note: Use this when the amusing quality is specifically that it makes people laugh.

example.english: This clip is really amusing—I laughed out loud watching it.
example.traditional: 呢段片真係好笑，我睇到笑咗出聲。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 pin2 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu3 ngo5 tai2 dou2 siu3 zo2 ceot1 seng1

rows.note: Use this for something entertaining or interesting in a broader sense, even when it is not laugh-out-loud funny.

example.english: This book about Hong Kong’s old districts is quite amusing.
example.traditional: 呢本講香港舊區嘅書幾有趣。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 gong2 hoeng1 gong2 gau6 keoi1 ge3 syu1 gei2 jau5 ceoi3
